orientation_note: Machine-relative, machine-as-person convention. FRONT = platen/paper side. The camera looks at the machine's front, rotated ~30 deg toward the machine's LEFT, so the machine's LEFT side faces the camera and appears on the RIGHT of the image; the machine's front face fills most of the frame. Confirmed by the base slab showing its (machine-left) side face on the image-right and by comparison with the mirror-image front-right view page009_img01. Thus 'front_left' corners are on the image-right, 'front_right' on the image-left; all back corners are on the far/shadowed side and are recorded as occluded.
